matches.snippet: A grind configuration that only uses cutsat, splitting, and the @ [lia] lemma set. Note: cutsat benefits from some amount of instantiation, e.g. Nat.max_def. Lemmas tagged with the @ [lia] attribute are instantiated via E-matching when running lia, while the much larger @ [grind] lemma set is left disabled.
